runtime/format#

The native layer under numbers/float: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under numbers/float: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native sprintf_values#

native sprintf_values(pattern is string, values is @any) is string

Existing core.format primitive; values are explicitly boxed at this ABI. Locale/shortest-decimal policy lives in the consuming std values.
